Join the Score-Driven Terms of Several Equations

Source: R/joint_filter.R
join_gas_terms.Rd

Replaces the modelterms7::gas() terms of a model, when there is more than one, with a single modelterms7::GasJoint() placed in the equation of the first of them under the key "gas_joint".

Usage

join_gas_terms(terms)

Arguments

terms

The built terms, a named list of named lists, one per distribution parameter.

Value

terms, with the score-driven terms joined where there are two or more.

Details

reject_incompatible() has already checked that each equation carries at most one such term and that no other structural term sits beside them. modelterms7::gas_joint() checks that the terms walk the same series and share one scaling, and fills the cross loadings that the p_cross of each term declares. A parameter that a p_cross names and that carries no gas() term joins the filter as a driver (modelterms7::GasDriver()): its predictor stays static and its score enters the driving vector. A single score-driven term with no driver is left as it is, after the same check of its p_cross.
